card.name: Linking words before stopping a drug
card.fires_on: Small linking words (was, or, been, for, permanently) that come right before a verb about stopping or withdrawing a drug, such as discontinue, withdrawn or reinitiated.

modes.label: Or before discontinue
modes.description: The word "or" in a list of dose actions, just before "permanently discontinue".
modes.example: reduce dose, temporarily withhold,<< or>> permanently discontinue SCEMBLIX [

modes.label: Helper verb before withdrawn
modes.description: A helper verb such as "been" or "was" that comes just before withdrawn or not reinitiated.
modes.example: The HDL-C levels remain depressed until fibrate therapy has<< been>> withdrawn

modes.label: Other lead-in words
modes.description: A word such as "for" or "permanently" that leads into a clinical action or outcome.
modes.example: immediately and<< permanently>> discontinue administration of ADCETRIS

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward the next word being a stop or withdraw verb, though the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before the label says a drug is stopped, withdrawn or discontinued.
